scripts.build:wasm:simd: rm -rf crates/blake3_wasm/pkg && RUSTFLAGS='-C opt-level=s -C target-feature=+simd128' wasm-pack build crates/blake3_wasm --scope fuzdev --target web --release --out-dir pkg && gro task scripts/patch_npm_package.task.ts crates/blake3_wasm/pkg
scripts.build:wasm:small: rm -rf crates/blake3_wasm_small/pkg && RUSTFLAGS='-C opt-level=s' wasm-pack build crates/blake3_wasm_small --scope fuzdev --target web --release --out-dir pkg && gro task scripts/patch_npm_package.task.ts crates/blake3_wasm_small/pkg
scripts.build:component: RUSTFLAGS='-C opt-level=3 -C target-feature=+simd128' cargo component build -p blake3_component --release && mkdir -p pkg/component && cp target/wasm32-wasip1/release/blake3_component.wasm pkg/component/
scripts.clean: cargo clean && rm -rf crates/blake3_wasm/pkg crates/blake3_wasm_small/pkg pkg && rm -rf benches/results
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:rust && npm run test:tooling && npm run lint && npm run lint:docs && cargo fmt --all --check && tsv format --check .
scripts.test: npm run typecheck:built && npm run test:wasm && npm run test:wasm:small && npm run test:component && npm run test:npm && npm run test:npm:small
scripts.compare:wasm: npm run build:wasm:simd && npm run test:wasm
scripts.compare:small: npm run build:wasm:small && npm run test:wasm:small
scripts.compare:component: npm run build:component && npm run test:component
scripts.compare: npm run compare:wasm && npm run compare:small && npm run compare:component
scripts.validate:npm: npm run test:npm && npm run test:npm:small
scripts.validate: npm run check && npm run build:wasm && npm run build:component && npm run test && npm run validate:size
scripts.bench: npm run bench:build && npm run bench:deno && npm run bench:node && npm run bench:bun && npm run bench:wasmtime:run && npm run bench:report && npm run validate:bench
scripts.bench:build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:component
scripts.bench:wasmtime: npm run build:component && npm run bench:wasmtime:run
